tools.name: diagram_find
tools.description: Lists this workspace's diagrams, latest version first, each with its family and brief's first line. query matches the title, key or brief, ignoring case; title matches come first.

tools.name: diagram_get
tools.description: Reads a diagram by id or key. tools.name: diagram_validate
tools.description: Checks a DSP scene or Mermaid text without saving it. Returns ok, errors and warnings, each with a code, the element if any, and a one-line fix.

tools.name: diagram_create
tools.description: Saves a new diagram from a DSP scene or Mermaid text; returns its id, revision 1 and hashes. key is your stable name for it, unique in the workspace: your repeat with the same key and content returns the existing diagram, not a copy. brief stores context for the next agent. Versions are kept until y

tools.name: diagram_edit
tools.description: Changes a saved diagram as a new revision; old ones stay. tools.name: diagram_render
tools.description: SVG and PNG links to a version, not the image, with hashes and engine version. A published diagram's links last until it's made private or deleted (url is its page); others, 7 days. preview adds a PNG. tools.name: diagram_history
tools.description: Lists a diagram's versions, newest first, with time, who made it (by), client, message, chain hash and counts of elements added, changed and removed. compare (from and to: revision numbers or dates) returns what changed between two versions instead.

tools.name: diagram_delete
tools.description: Deletes a diagram with all its versions. undo restores it within 24 hours; after that it is gone. Asks the user to confirm.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: diagram_edit · Private data: diagram_render, diagram_share · Public sink: diagram_get, diagram_share · Destructive: diagram_create, diagram_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: diagram_edit · Private data: diagram_render, diagram_share · Public sink: diagram_get, diagram_share · Destructive: diagram_create, diagram_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "diagram_find" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Lists this workspace's diagrams, latest version first. query matches the title, key or brief, ignoring case." → after: "Lists this workspace's diagrams, latest version first, each with its family and brief's first line. query matches the title, key or brief, ignoring case; title matches come first."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
